tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background behind every screen. Trill's warm paper in light, a roasted near-black in dark.

tokens.name: surface-container-lowest
tokens.usage: The rare white card that must pop off a container (a type specimen, a QR code plate).

tokens.name: surface-container-low
tokens.usage: Quiet grouped content: settings groups, summary lists, list cards on surface.

tokens.name: surface-container
tokens.usage: Navigation bar, default filled cards, unselected segments.

tokens.name: surface-container-high
tokens.usage: Search bars, text-field fills, unselected button-group segments, stat tiles.

tokens.name: surface-container-highest
tokens.usage: Pressed rows, track of sliders and progress, the highest card in a stack.

tokens.name: on-surface
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on every surface and surface-container token.

tokens.name: on-surface-variant
tokens.usage: Supporting text, captions, inactive nav labels and icons, on every surface token.

tokens.name: outline
tokens.usage: Outlined buttons and chips, text-field borders, dividers that must be seen (3:1 on surface).

tokens.name: outline-variant
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines inside cards, chart gridlines. Never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Primary actions (filled button, active slider, progress), selected states, emphasis words in display copy. As text, on surface and surface-container tokens.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Label and icon on a primary fill.

tokens.name: primary-container
tokens.usage: Hero cards, the active nav indicator, tonal callouts (Trill's Daily mix).

tokens.name: on-primary-container
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary-container.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Second voice: selected segments in settings, links inside dense UI, chart series two. As text, on surface tokens.

tokens.name: on-secondary
tokens.usage: Label and icon on a secondary fill.

tokens.name: secondary-container
tokens.usage: Tonal buttons, selected filter chips, the collection card in Shelfie.

tokens.name: on-secondary-container
tokens.usage: Text and icons on secondary-container.

tokens.name: tertiary
tokens.usage: Third voice for playful accents: badges, tertiary chart series, easter eggs.

tokens.name: on-tertiary
tokens.usage: Label and icon on a tertiary fill.

tokens.name: tertiary-container
tokens.usage: Tonal cards that need to differ from primary (Trill's Note Rush), avatar shapes.

tokens.name: on-tertiary-container
tokens.usage: Text and icons on tertiary-container.

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: The one loud fill per screen: a large FAB (Pinhole's Shoot), a streak, a scorecard. Not for text.

tokens.name: on-highlight
tokens.usage: Label and icon on a highlight fill.

tokens.name: positive
tokens.usage: Gains, success, delivered, "good" deltas. As text with an up-arrow glyph, on surface tokens.

tokens.name: positive-container
tokens.usage: Success banners (Trill's Lovely.), gain pills.

tokens.name: on-positive-container
tokens.usage: Text and icons on positive-container.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Errors, losses, destructive confirmations. As text with a down-arrow glyph, on surface tokens.

tokens.name: on-error
tokens.usage: Label and icon on an error fill.

tokens.name: error-container
tokens.usage: Error banners, loss pills, the destructive tonal button.

tokens.name: on-error-container
tokens.usage: Text and icons on error-container.

tokens.name: inverse-surface
tokens.usage: Snackbars and the dark chip that floats over content.

tokens.name: inverse-on-surface
tokens.usage: Text on inverse-surface.

tokens.name: inverse-primary
tokens.usage: Action text inside a snackbar.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dims the screen behind bottom sheets and dialogs.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset. Alias of on-surface so it clears 3:1 on every surface and fill.

families.sans: "Google Sans Flex", "Google Sans", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif
families.mono: "Google Sans Code", "Geist Mono", ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace

styles.name: display-large
styles.usage: Celebration and outcome screens: one per screen, centred.

styles.name: display-medium
styles.usage: Onboarding titles and lesson outcomes.

styles.name: display-small
styles.usage: Home greetings and detail-page titles; set one emphasised word in italic primary.

styles.name: numeral-large
styles.usage: The single figure a screen exists to show: balance, amount being entered, MWh made. Tabular numerals.

styles.name: numeral-medium
styles.usage: Price on a detail screen, countdowns, the number on a stat hero.

styles.name: numeral-small
styles.usage: Values in stat tiles and summary rows; pair the unit in title-small.

styles.name: headline-large
styles.usage: Top-level tab titles (Explore, Activity, Orders).

styles.name: headline-medium
styles.usage: Pushed-screen titles and sheet titles.

styles.name: headline-small
styles.usage: Section titles inside a screen.

styles.name: title-large
styles.usage: Card titles and section heads with an action beside them.

styles.name: title-medium
styles.usage: List-item headline, card headline in dense layouts.

styles.name: title-small
styles.usage: Row labels with weight, units next to numerals.

styles.name: body-large
styles.sample: Nutty brown butter, puddles of dark chocolate, a pinch of flaky salt.
styles.usage: Descriptions and reading copy.

styles.name: body-medium
styles.sample: Each tile is a company, sized by its market value.
styles.usage: Default UI copy, supporting text in cards and lists.

styles.name: body-small
styles.usage: Captions, metadata, chart axes.

styles.name: label-large
styles.usage: Buttons, chips, segmented buttons.

styles.name: label-medium
styles.usage: Navigation-bar labels (bold when active), small chips.

styles.name: label-small
styles.usage: Badges and status pills.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase kicker above a title or a list section (TODAY, LATELY SPOTTED 12). Always uppercase, middle-dot separators.

styles.name: data-medium
styles.usage: Codes, hex values, times in plans, ISBNs.

styles.name: data-small
styles.usage: Timestamps and trailing metadata in lists.

tokens.name: space-0-5
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked segments of a grouped list or connected button group.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label nudge, badge padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips and between sibling cards in a row.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked cards; padding of compact chips.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen side gutter on phones; default card padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Padding of hero and tonal cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Space between sections; gutter on unfolded/tablet layouts.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Space above a screen title; between major groups.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Breathing room around a hero numeral or illustration.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Top padding of celebration screens.

tokens.name: shape-none
tokens.usage: Full-bleed media and maps.

tokens.name: shape-xs
tokens.usage: Inner corners of grouped list segments; badges on images.

tokens.name: shape-sm
tokens.usage: Inner corners of connected button-group segments; text-field inner shapes.

tokens.name: shape-md
tokens.usage: Small tiles, thumbnails, outlined text fields.

tokens.name: shape-lg
tokens.usage: FABs, stat tiles, menus.

tokens.name: shape-lg-increased
tokens.usage: List cards and medium cards.

tokens.name: shape-xl
tokens.usage: Hero cards, settings groups (outer corners), bottom-sheet top corners, large FAB.

tokens.name: shape-xl-increased
tokens.usage: Illustration panels and detail-page headers.

tokens.name: shape-xxl
tokens.usage: Expressive hero media corners.

tokens.name: shape-full
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, search bars, nav indicator, pills: anything that is pressed.

tokens.name: elevation-0
tokens.usage: Default: cards separate by tone, not shadow.

tokens.name: elevation-1
tokens.usage: Elevated button, a card lifted while dragged.

tokens.name: elevation-3
tokens.usage: FABs and the floating cart bar (Dollop's View your box).

tokens.name: touch-target
tokens.usage: Minimum hit area for every control.

tokens.name: button-sm
tokens.usage: Default button height.

tokens.name: button-md
tokens.usage: Primary action at the bottom of a flow (Review order, Place order).

tokens.name: nav-bar
tokens.usage: Bottom navigation bar height, excluding the gesture inset.

tokens.name: nav-indicator-w
tokens.usage: Width of the active pill in the navigation bar.

tokens.name: icon
tokens.usage: Material Symbols Rounded at its default optical size.

tokens.name: avatar
tokens.usage: Shape avatars in list items.

tokens.name: fab
tokens.usage: Standard FAB; the large FAB is 80px tall.

tokens.name: state-hover
tokens.usage: State layer over a control on hover.

tokens.name: state-focus
tokens.usage: State layer when focused (with the focus ring).

tokens.name: state-pressed
tokens.usage: State layer while pressed.

tokens.name: state-disabled
tokens.usage: Opacity of disabled content; disabled containers use 0.12.
